howto.name: Upload a FLAC file
howto.text: Drop a .flac file. FLAC is lossless, so the source is the best possible input for an encode.

howto.name: PrivaTools encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: FLAC is lossless, so the encoder is working from the best possible source. Expect roughly a 5-10x size reduction.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Expect roughly a 5–10x size reduction. This step is one-way: the detail MP3 discards cannot be recovered, so keep the FLAC if it is your master copy.

faq.q: Will I lose quality converting FLAC to MP3?
faq.a: Yes — FLAC is lossless and MP3 is lossy, so the conversion discards some audio data. At 256–320 kbps the difference is inaudible to most people, but it's a one-way trade for a smaller, universally-compatible file.

faq.q: Why convert FLAC to MP3 at all?
faq.a: MP3 plays on virtually every device and is roughly 3–6× smaller than FLAC — ideal for phones, portable players, and sharing.
